FAQ

For retail and private-label buyers FAQ

Can retail packaging be customized?

Pack count, artwork, labels and cartons can be reviewed for the selected food-paper product, but every detail must be confirmed before quotation and production.

Are coated-paper samples supplied by length?

Yes. A 200 m coated-paper sample can be provided in the requested specification after construction, width and shipment details are confirmed.

Can we use one document for every private-label SKU?

No. Document scope should be checked against the exact material, ink, construction, intended use and destination market.
